title: RAW Carduus preserves authority-scoped classifications and a cultivated thorny counterexample
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Complete cached Lonitzer1551 Carduus account first says both thorny and thornless types are cultivated, later attributes wild-Scolymos versus cultivated-Cinara distinction to Greeks, and separately describes a widespread wild type. Preserve attribution and independent cultivation/thorn predicates rather than identifying cultivated with thornless or treating every name as one global modern species. The explicitly cultivated thorny type is a real counterexample to that identification. Source-only proposal,0confirmedVoynich meanings; novelty and target viability unreviewed.

source.work: Naturalis historiae opus novum, Tomus I
source.layer: CAMENA human-typed text, with acknowledged uncorrected errors. Full entry bytes preserved; selected claim-bearing wording checked against full native print pages. Not a new fully diplomatic edition.

actual_connected_constraints.span: Duo traduntur huius genera, alterum aculeatum, alterum minime , hortense utrumque.
actual_connected_constraints.content: Two reported types differ in thorns, but BOTH are cultivated. Thus cultivated does not imply thornless in this account.

actual_connected_constraints.span: Altera species priori ex omniparte similis est, nisi quod aculeis caret.
actual_connected_constraints.content: The second type is described as otherwise like the first, except that it lacks thorns. It is more sought for food; food preference is a further relation, not the cultivation predicate.
Tragus supplies a specific Cinara identification; preserve the attribution rather than convert it into an uncontested synonym table.

actual_connected_constraints.span: Graeci hoc faciunt discrimen, quod scolymos est ferus et silvester, Cinara vero domita cultu, ruditate mitior et altilis.
actual_connected_constraints.content: The Greek-attributed distinction uses wild versus tamed-by-cultivation; it does not erase the initial two cultivated thorn variants.

actual_connected_constraints.span: Praeterea silvestris est quaedam Cardui species, in agris passim impedimentum
actual_connected_constraints.content: The account adds a wild type separately; it is not licensed to equate this wild occurrence with every use of the initial name.

design.candidate_content: A connected botanical comparison can maintain authority-indexed NAME(x), CULTIVATED(x), THORNY(x), FOOD_PREFERENCE(x) and RESEMBLES_EXCEPT(x,y,THORNS). The minimum retained counterexample is CULTIVATED(x) AND THORNY(x), making global CULTIVATED=>NOT_THORNY inconsistent with the source. This is an actual source content relation, not a mapping engine or a Voynich claim.
